description: Generates client-ready, single-page HTML proposals for freelancers, solo consultants, and small studios. This skill should be used when a user wants to create a polished sales proposal, quote, or pitch document to send to a client. Triggered by requests like 帮我写个接单提案, 给客户做个报价单, 生成服务方案书, or 做个能发给甲方的方
